text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —What was that just now, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
How strange. Power is surging from all 
over my body...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Mmm. Well, whatever the reason is, who 
cares? For now, the important thing is—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Guess that means I'll have fun running 
tomorrow too!
